clusters.label: Increasing temperature
clusters.definition: An upward change in temperature used as a physical condition for assessing temperature-dependent behavior.
clusters.reason: All evidence identifies the same direction of temperature change. Materials, temperature ranges, mechanisms, response directions, and experimental or theoretical status qualify the associated claims rather than this temperature condition.

clusters.label: Enhanced thermally generated voltage
clusters.definition: An increase in thermally generated voltage arising from ionic transport.
clusters.reason: Both mentions denote enhancement of the same ionic voltage outcome. Cu–Cl coordination and hydrogen-ion movement with anion restriction are distinct attributed mechanisms retained in their respective claims.
